g.text: C23 PutObjs custody and cache incarnation
stable owner record exists; reserve800 uncredited responsibility
load head; assign last then read next; preserve phase and cursor
old tail link then shared head; count still old
empty-list tail branch then count increment
unknown release retains duty; never guess unlocked
same native owner; reentry still excluded
independent protected release publication; not entire free receipt
drain readers and qualify all finalization callers
cache address may be reused; old opaque receipt stays stale
TclThreadAllocObj/MoveObjs may reuse objects before local lastPtr; no old-tail dereference
